classification.difficultyReason: Convert both diameters to radii, calculate the cylindrical capacity and subtract the volume of four spheres.

content.prompt: Tennis balls are packaged in cylindrical canisters. A tennis ball can be considered to be a sphere of diameter $70\text{ mm}$. If the canister has base diameter $75\text{ mm}$ and height $286\text{ mm}$, and each canister holds four balls, find the volume of unused space inside the canister, correct to two decimal places.

answer.short:
$545\,131.78\text{ mm}^3$.

Subtract the volume of four spherical balls from the volume of the cylindrical canister.
answer.worked:
The canister radius is $37.5\text{ mm}$ and each ball has radius $35\text{ mm}$.
$$\begin{align*}V_{\text{canister}}&=\pi r^2h\\V_{\text{canister}}&=\pi\times37.5^2\times286\\V_{\text{four balls}}&=4\times\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\\V_{\text{four balls}}&=4\times\frac{4}{3}\pi\times35^3\\V_{\text{unused}}&=\pi\times37.5^2\times286-4\times\frac{4}{3}\pi\times35^3\\V_{\text{unused}}&=\frac{5205625\pi}{30}\\V_{\text{unused}}&\approx545\,131.78\text{ mm}^3\end{align*}$$
